channel.title: George Stathopoulos's blog
channel.description: Notes from the gap between what exists and what people actually need.

item.title: Hello, world. Again.
item.description: Why a support person with a day job keeps building tools, and why each one now gets a story.

item.title: Gatehouse: who is spending my AI money?
item.description: Every AI plugin shares one bill and one API key, and nobody tells you who ate what. So I built a gatehouse.

item.title: Helpdesk Hero: please stop emailing me your password
item.description: The first five emails of a support ticket are always the same questions. I tried to make them unnecessary.

item.title: Fixpass: point at the problem, skip the password
item.description: Which button is broken? A plugin that lets you point at the problem, and lets support in safely.

item.title: Mitos Checklist: Greek bureaucracy, tick by tick
item.description: Starting a business in Greece means a pile of procedures. The data exists. I turned it into checklists you can actually follow.

item.title: Mission Control: counting visits without selling anyone out
item.description: I wanted to know if anyone visits my sites. Without cookies, ads or a spyware dashboard. So I built a very private, very boring one.

item.title: SheetPilot: your spreadsheet, but it talks back
item.description: Most teams keep what matters in spreadsheets, and then only store it. SheetPilot reads the sheet and tells you what stands out. Nothing leaves your browser.
